purpose: Source-universe overlay for the single Stödassistenten discovery and truth pipeline. It references the canonical source registry instead of duplicating source metadata, and it defines what a discovery source may and may not prove before verified support or opportunity records are created.

required_verification_before_action: Verify with the foundation itself whether an application route exists now, including current application documents, deadline or application period, target group and where the application must be sent.
Keep Länsstyrelsernas registry role as discovery only: a registered active foundation does not by itself prove that money is currently open for application or that a user is eligible.
Do not republish people listed in the registry merely because the registry exposes board members, auditors or signatories; the public product needs organization-level facts only.
